This mod, currently, gives Shane's 4 heart event sprite googly eyes.

Maybe everyone could get googly eyes in the future? Who knows? We may some day have the technology to do so.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763028878.png[/img]
The mod exists!
[size=1]And Shane has googly eyes.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029577.png[/img]
This mod was inspired by a comment on a [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/1x47gph/dude/]Reddit post[/url]. I've asked, and when I hear back whether they want credit here or not, their name will go right here!

If you've made a Shane recolour or complete sprite mod and want me to add compatibility for... some reason, just let me know and I'll do it.
